meta.name: flutter-use-column-row-first
meta.description: Use when building any Flutter screen or component to choose responsive Row, Column, Expanded, Flexible, and Spacer layouts before fixed-size or coordinate-based alternatives.

copy.tagline_en: Prefer responsive Row, Column, and Flex layouts over fixed sizes in Flutter

howto.what: 当用户要求构建 Flutter 布局时，Claude 会优先使用 Column、Row、Expanded、Flexible、Spacer 等弹性布局，避免固定尺寸或坐标定位。
howto.when: 当用户请求构建任何 Flutter 屏幕或组件，或涉及布局代码时触发。

say.text: 用Column和Row布局这个Flutter页面，避免固定尺寸。
这个组件应该用Expanded分配剩余空间。
say.note: 避免硬编码宽度或高度。

say.text: 用Spacer代替固定间距，保持响应式。
say.note: 布局更灵活适应不同屏幕。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a Flutter layout, Claude will prefer Column, Row, Expanded, Flexible, and Spacer over fixed-size or coordinate-based alternatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to build any Flutter screen, component, or layout code.

say_en.text: Use Column and Row for this Flutter page, avoid fixed sizes.
This widget should use Expanded for remaining space.
Replace fixed spacing with Spacer for responsiveness.
